articles.title: Google Search Makes It Harder to See Where a Link Really Goes Before You Click
articles.summary:
Google has begun routing some organic Search result links through opaque google.com/goto?url=… redirects, reducing users’ ability to independently inspect a destination URL before clicking. The change appears designed to raise the technical and financial cost of mass scraping.
